neighbours.label: The token ' hard' / ' Hard', strongest in set phrases and names (hard work, Hard Rock, hard drive, a hard place)
fire: Her success came from years of hard work in the lab.
Our band once played at a Hard Rock hotel in Florida.
He copied the photos onto an external hard drive last night.
The strike left the mayor between a rock and a hard place.
Nothing replaces hard work when you train for a marathon.
The technician said the old hard drive had finally failed.
They sell cider, both sweet and hard, at the orchard.
The Bruce Willis movie Die Hard is set on Christmas Eve.
quiet: Her success came from years of patient study in the lab.
Our band once played at a seaside hotel in Florida.
He copied the photos onto an external memory stick last night.
The strike left the mayor with a difficult choice to make.
Nothing replaces steady effort when you train for a marathon.
The technician said the old power supply had finally failed.
They sell cider, both sweet and tough, at the orchard.
The Bruce Willis movie Armageddon is set on an asteroid.

notes: Card: ' Hard' x11, ' hard' x5 of the top 32; early layer, small max (1.80). Probes: 'hard work' 0.78, 'Hard Rock' 0.61, 'hard drive' 0.39, 'a hard place' 0.33, plain adjective/adverb use 0.09-0.24; 'Hardy' 0.03, ' tough' 0.22.
